import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
for name in ['Demo pair 4']:
    g=G[name+' input']
    W=30
    okc=[]
    for q in range(2, W):
        mm=sum(sum(1 for r in range(30) if g[r][c]!=8 and g[r][c-q]!=g[r][c]) for c in range(q,W-q*? )) 
    # simple: does col c equal col c-p on average over rows excluding 8?
    best=[]
    for p in range(1,W):
        tot=sum(1 for r in range(30) for c in range(p,W) if g[r][c]!=8 and g[r][c]==g[r][c-p])
        n8p=sum(1 for r in range(30) for c in range(p,W) if g[r][c]==8)
        best.append((tot/(30-(p)*?),p,n8p))
    print(best[:10])

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
# Majority-vote reconstruction per residue class, excluding 8s. Then compare against demo outputs.
def build(g, th, tw, exclude=None):
    p=[[0]*tw for _ in range(th)]; n=[[0]*tw for _ in range(th)]
    for r in range(len(g)):
        for c in range(len(g[0])):
            v=g[r][c]
            if v in (exclude or set()): continue
            i,j=r%th,c%tw
            n[i][j]+=1; p[i][j]+=v
    return [[p[i][j]//n[i][j] for j in range(tw)] for i in range(th)]
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    g=G[name+' input']; o=G[name+' output']
    th,tw=len(o),len(o[0])
    rec=build(g,th,tw,{8})
    mism=[(i,j,rec[i][j],o[i][j]) for i in range(th) for j in range(tw) if rec[i][j]!=o[i][j]]
    print(name,'recon:',rec,'\nmismatches:',mism)
